question: Which of the following is an example of eastern coast port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chennai Port**, formerly known as Madras Port, is located on the eastern coast of India in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is one of the largest ports in India and serves as a major hub for trade and commerce in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
• Chennai Port handles a variety of cargo, including petroleum products, containers, automobiles, and general cargo.
 
• It plays a crucial role in India's export-import activities, particularly with Southeast Asian and East Asian countries.
 
• Chennai Port is strategically important due to its proximity to industrial zones and its well-developed infrastructure for maritime trade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eastern Coast Ports in India**

 
 
• Other major ports along the eastern coast include Visakhapatnam Port (Andhra Pradesh), Paradip Port (Odisha), and Kolkata Port (West Bengal).
 
• These ports facilitate trade across the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean, connecting India to Southeast Asia and beyond.
 
 
 
• **Western Coast Ports**
 
 
• Ports like Kandla, Mumbai, and New Mangalore are located on the western coast of India.
 
• They primarily handle trade with the Middle East, Africa, and Europe.
 
 
 
• **Chennai Port Features**
 
 
• It is one of the oldest ports in India, established in the 19th century.
 
• The port has modern facilities, including container terminals and roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) facilities for automobile exports.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Ports in India**
 
 
• India has 13 major ports and over 200 minor ports, contributing significantly to the country's economy.
 
• Ports serve as gateways for international trade, ensuring the smooth movement of goods and raw materials.
